svg.aria-label: UML component diagram of the Self-Service Coffee Kiosk as a three-layer architecture. Presentation layer: User Interface component. Business layer: Order Manager, Payment Service and Receipt Printer components (Order Manager and Payment Service are supplied in the brief). Data layer: Menu and Pricing Data Store component. User Interface requires an Order Interface provided by Order Manager. Order Manager requires a Payment Interface from Payment Service, a Receipt Interface from Receipt Printer, and a Database Interface from the Menu and Pricing Data Store. Payment Service requires a Card Network interface from an external Card Payment Gateway. Receipt Printer requires a Printer Hardware interface from an external thermal printer.
svg.font-family: Segoe UI, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: touch screen · menu, cart, card prompt

svg.text: A socket gripping a ball is an assembly connector: the requester holds the socket, so a request flows socket → ball. Solid lines are in-process calls unless the protocol label says otherwise.
